summary: P3 Setup + Migration Support Testing: Migration Mode toggle works correctly (localStorage persistence, date picker behavior). Settings page shows 'Run Setup' and 'Migration Mode' cards with correct icons. Found 2 issues: 1) Formation signs in Settings page still show OLD Unsplash URLs (database has old values), 2) 'Launch Setup Wizard' button redirects to /app/setup which doesn't exist as a route, causing redirect to home page.

ui_bugs.issue: Button redirects to /app/setup which is not a valid route. Falls through to catch-all route and redirects to home page instead of showing setup wizard.

integration_issues.issue: Settings page shows OLD Unsplash placeholder URLs for formation signs because the database still has old values. The DEFAULT_FMN_1/2 constants in Settings.jsx were updated but only affect fallback when settings.fmn_sign_1_url is empty.

action_items: Add /app/setup route to App.js that shows SetupWizard component (or modify the 'Launch Setup Wizard' button to reset is_setup_complete flag)
Update formation sign URLs in database via backend API or add a migration script to update existing settings with new URLs
